# cloudxino_load_balancer (Resource)

A load balancer: a public IP that spreads traffic over CC2 servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudxino_load_balancer" "web" {
  name = "web"

  forwarding_rule = [
    { entry_protocol = "http", entry_port = 80, target_port = 8080 },
    { entry_protocol = "tcp", entry_port = 443, target_port = 8443 },
  ]

  health_check = {
    protocol = "http"
    path     = "/healthz"
  }

  target_ids = cloudxino_server.web[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `forwarding_rule` (Attributes List) tcp or http on `entry_port` to `target_port` on every target (https passes through as tcp). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forwarding_rule))
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) `round_robin` or `least_connections`.
- `health_check` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `target_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the servers that get the traffic.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String)
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--forwarding_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `forwarding_rule`

Required:

- `entry_port` (Number)
- `entry_protocol` (String)
- `target_port` (Number)

Optional:

- `target_protocol` (String) Defaults to entry_protocol.


<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Optional:

- `path` (String) For http checks.
- `port` (Number) Left out = the first rule's target port.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` or `http`.

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_load_balancer.web <load_balancer_id>
```
